tool_arguments.query: Super Micro Computer AI server revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 quarter ended December 2025

events.content: Super Micro Computer AI server revenue Q3 fiscal 2026 quarter ended December 2025

There is a period mismatch: Super Micro Computer’s quarter ended December 31, 2025 was **Q2 fiscal 2026**, not Q3 fiscal 2025. [[1]] 

For that December 2025 quarter, Supermicro reported **$12.7 billion of total net sales** ($12.682 billion precisely), versus $5.0 billion in Q1 FY2026 and $5.7 billion in Q2 FY2025. [[2]] 

The company described demand for its AI-server and storage technology as a key driver, but its reported financial statements disclose consolidated net sales rather than a separate quantified “AI server revenue” line item. [[2]] 

For reference, Supermicro’s actual **Q3 fiscal 2025** ended **March 31, 2025**, rather than December 2025. [[3]]

[S1.1] Super Micro Computer, Inc. - Supermicro Announces Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results — https://ir.supermicro.com/news/news-details/2026/Supermicro-Announces-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx

tool_arguments.query: Super Micro Computer latest revenue guidance fiscal year 2026

events.content: Super Micro Computer latest revenue guidance fiscal year 2026

Super Micro Computer’s latest **next-quarter revenue guidance** is **$14.5 billion–$15.5 billion** for fiscal Q1 2027, which ends September 30, 2026. [[1]] 

For the full fiscal year 2027, Supermicro guided to **$65.0 billion–$72.0 billion** of net sales. [[1]] 

The guidance was issued with its FY2026 results on August 11, 2026; FY2026 revenue was $39.1 billion. [[1]]
